ينتشقون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَشِقُونَ (yantašiqūna) /jan.ta.ʃi.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
# يُنْتَشَقُونَ (yuntašaqūna) /jun.ta.ʃa.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَشَقَ (intašaqa)
